title: Abundance in secret: a review of the genus <i>Leptobrachium</i> (Anura, Megophryidae) in India, with descriptions of two new species.

readScopes.readScope: Leptobrachium bompu: Selected individual species accounts and molecular methods in the Indian genus revision; original factual summaries only, no images or supplementary datasets reproduced; two newly described taxa absent from pinned catalogue kept in a separate pending ledger; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
